items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: George Washington, Tee Paul, Johnny, myself, the wrestler Don, and Joe Reni. All of us. All of us. All of us in the band was short.

ctx.x: Well, uh. Ask him who was with Poe Ree's band. Poe Ree's? Poe Ree.

Who was with Poe Ree's band? With Poe Ree? Yeah. You mean, uh. Venice player? Uh-huh. Uh, me. His son. Uh, Louie, Louie Gallo, piano player. Uh-huh. And Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, Johnny. Uh, uh. Did he have a trumpet?
